simple.inThisVerse: The selected word is tied to חָמַם (H2552) in the Hebrew source text. Part of speech: v.

simple.summary: חָמַם (châmam) means to be hot (literally or figuratively) First listed occurrence: 1Kgs 1 2.

definitions.usage: enflame self, get (have) heat, be (wax) hot, (be, wax) warm (self, at).
definitions.full: H2552. chamam [ חָמַם ] verb be or become warm (Late Hebrew id. , Pi`el, make warm , Aramaic , חֲמַם be warm ; Arabic become hot , of water; also heat, kindle fire in ) — Qal Perfect חַם Psa 39:4 ; Exod 16:21 ; וְחַם consecutive 1Kin 1:2 ; Eccl 4:11 ; חַמּוֺתִ֫י Isa 44:16 ; Imperfect יָחֹם 44:16 ; וַיָּ֫חָם 2Kin 4:34 ; Isa 44:15 ; also יִחַם 1Kin 1:1 ; יֵחַם Deut 19:6 ; יֵחָ֑ם Eccl 4:11 ; 3 feminine singular תֵּחַם Ezek 24:11 ; יֵחַמּוּ Hosea 7:7 ; וַיֶּחֱמוּ Gen 30:39 ; וַיֵּחַמְנָה 30:38 (last seven forms could be also from יחם q. v.; but no decisive evidence that this v is used in Qal; they are placed under חמם by Thes Ew § 193 a Ol § 243 b ; see also Kö i. 365, 417 ff. , who on account of יחם Pi`el Infinitive 30:41 ; 31:10 , derives last two, needlessly, from יחם ); Infinitive לַחְמָם Isa 47:14 , compare Job 30:4 (where, however, ׳ל is from לֶחֶם Mich Di unless (Luzz Che) we read לְחַמֵּם Pi`el Infinitive in both); חֹם 1Sam 11:9 ; Hag 1:6 ; Neh 7:3 ; suffix חֻמּוֺ Job 6:17 ; חֻמָּם Jer 51:39 ; — 1 literally, be or grow warm Exod 16:21 (P; subject שֶׁמֶשׁ ), compare 1Sam 11:9 ; Neh 7:3 and Job 6:17 (suffix of impersonal subject); from fire Isa 44:15-16 , (twice in verse); 47:14 (compare above); natural heat 1Kin 1:1-2 ,(by personal contact), so 2Kin 4:34 ; Eccl 4:11 (twice in verse), from clothing Hag 1:6 ; of Jerusalem under figure of pot or caldron Ezek 24:11 . 2 figurative, subject לִבִּי Psa 39:4 (|| תִבְעַראֵֿשׁ בַהֲגִיגִי ), compare Deut 19:6 ; of conspirators Hosea 7:7 ; Chaldeans Jer 51:39 . 3 of heat in conception (animals) Gen 30:38-39 , (compare יחם ). Niph`al Participle באלים נֵחָמִים Isa 57:5 (Kö i. 371 ), inflame oneself with , of idolatry. Pi`el Imperfect 3feminine singular תְּחַמֵּם Job 39:14 keep eggs warm (of ostrich). Hithpa`el Imperfect יִתְחַמָּם warm oneself Job 31:20 כְּבָשִׂים מִגֵּז by means of fleece of sheep.
